item.title: RTT: Role of dendritic cells in immunoregulation and immune tolerance: mechanisms and strategies for pharmacological modulation (Univ. PERUGIA)
item.description:
Deadline: 2026-12-28 23:59
Institution: Univ. PERUGIA, Perugia
Field: Biology / 05/BIOS-11 Farmacologia

The research will investigate the role of distinct dendritic cell subsets in regulating immune responses under physiological and pathological conditions. The cellular and molecular mechanisms governing their activation and functions will be explored, with particular attention to their role in the induction and maintenance of immune tolerance. Cellular, molecular and pharmacological approaches will be used to explore strategies for modulating dendritic cell function, including nanoparticle-based systems for the delivery of biologically active substances. item.title: RTT: Rif. 6267_All. 2 - Physiology of the gastrointestinal tract and intestinal barrier in response to nutrients, pollutants and xenobiotics (Univ. BOLOGNA)
item.description:
Deadline: 2026-12-03 23:59
Institution: Univ. BOLOGNA, Bologna
Field: Biology / 05/BIOS-06 Fisiologia

The project aims to investigate the cellular and molecular mechanisms regulating gastrointestinal physiology and intestinal barrier integrity under physiological and pathological conditions. The effects of nutrients, bioactive compounds, environmental pollutants and xenobiotics on intestinal homeostasis will be examined, with particular attention to epithelial permeability, inflammatory responses, oxidative stress and interactions with the gut microbiota. The activities may combine in vitro, ex vivo and in vivo experimental models, biochemical and molecular techniques, imaging and functional barrier analyses, within a physiological and translational framework.
